dependency_edges.handoff: economic comparison is paired with energy-efficiency evidence before recommendations
spatial source comparison motivates fleet-share emission accounting
generation source affects EV-attributed emissions and therefore AHP pollution preference
the Bass adoption function becomes the Norton substitution basis
forecast EV/CV counts supply the 2045 resource calculation
well-to-wheel comparison motivates explicit fossil and electricity accounting
total EV electricity demand is allocated across generation alternatives
cost criteria from economic analysis enter the final generation decision
